pages.text:
Harbor exception card: a seal breach requires a quarantine photograph and a
quality officer signature before release.

paragraphs.text:
Harbor exception card: a seal breach requires a quarantine photograph and a

pages.text:
Harbor outage card: local drafts expire after 6 hours. Expired drafts must be
recaptured; they are never silently signed.

paragraphs.text:
Harbor outage card: local drafts expire after 6 hours. Expired drafts must be

pages.text:
Harbor recall card: a released box can be recalled within 36 hours by the
quality officer; the original receipt remains immutable.

paragraphs.text:
Harbor recall card: a released box can be recalled within 36 hours by the

pages.text:
Harbor recovery card: DQ-RED is cleared only after 5 consecutive valid samples
from the primary probe.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text:
Harbor dispatch card: the destination accepts a released box only when both
the receipt ID and the release code are present.

paragraphs.text:
Harbor dispatch card: the destination accepts a released box only when both

pages.text:
Harbor release code: the release code is generated by quality review, not by
the driver or the temperature sensor.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text:
Harbor special route: the island route has a 32-minute unloading reservation.
This reservation is not a receipt window.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text:
Harbor terminology: POD means proof of delivery. A POD alone is not a quality
release decision.

pages.text:
Harbor audit card: each correction event records actor, UTC time, reason, and
the previous receipt ID.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text:
Harbor alarm card: temperature alerts are acknowledged by the duty operator;
acknowledgement does not authorize release.

pages.text:
Harbor battery card: a probe with less than 15 percent battery must be
replaced before a new journey.

paragraphs.text:

pages.text:
Harbor packing card: the logger is positioned beside the central package, not
against the outside wall.

Harbor archive card: signed receipts are retained for 400 days independently
of photograph retention.

production receipt endpoint.

Harbor duplicate card: retries preserve the original handover sequence; a new
sequence denotes a separate handover attempt.

Harbor fallback card: handwritten notes may accompany a review but cannot
replace missing probe samples.

queue; no personal phone numbers are specified.

arrival. The procedure defines custody evidence, not insurance or medical
policy.
